name: skill-activate
description: Activate one or more skills (bundles) for this task: load each skill's member tools and SKILL.md instructions. Prefer `skills` to activate several in one call. For imported Anthropic skills, pass optional `reference` with a single `skill` to load one text file from references/ or assets/. Activation does not grant new authority — member tools still respect allowed_callers and action_risk, and a skill whose tools are all reserved for other agents is refused: delegate to its owner instead. When running on a bound task, the active set is persisted for wake re-load automatically.

inputs.skill: string? (one skill bundle name, e.g. tasks)
inputs.skills: string[]? (several skill names in one call; preferred when activating more than one)
inputs.reference: string? (optional path under references/ or assets/, e.g. common-clauses.md; single-skill only)
